verdict.rationale: Ramp Treasury lets operating cash earn yield inside Ramp: the Checking Account pays 2% APY, and reserve cash can earn up to 4.46% in an Investment Account. The Banking API exposes these accounts and their balances. Caveats are that the deposits are held by partner bank First Internet Bank of Indiana (Ramp is not a bank), the Investment Account needs at least $5,000, and the Managed Portfolio is in limited release. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the yield in practice, and clarity on how the partner-bank structure fits 'no separate institution'.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can earn yield on operating cash balances without moving funds to a separate institution
